label: WRONG
reason: Every multi-component radix file exports meta<Component> (accordion.ws.ts, switch.ws.ts, dialog.ws.ts), but label.ws.ts is the only single-component file and exports bare `meta`, matching the repo's single-component scheme: generate-arg-types/src/cli.ts emits bare `props` when componentDocs.length === 1 (label.props.ts) and all sdk-components-react *.ws files export `meta` (its metas.ts re-exports `meta as X`). New single-component radix files are a recurring category that would be falsely flagged; nothing lints names (.oxlintrc.json).

label: ACCEPT
reason: apps/builder, css-data and 39 other manifests depend on @webstudio-is/tsconfig via workspace:*, while packages/sdk-cli/package.json uses workspace:^ (as for all its workspace deps); sdk-cli could follow the scheme as easily and shares no reason to differ, so it is a choice (R8) and a look, and nothing enforces it (check-package-boundaries.mjs only checks private deps; no syncpack-like config in package.json). Hesitated with WRONG incidental/legit_outliers since the specifier has no effect for a private package's devDependency.
